data.title: BANIJAY AMERICAS' Acclaimed Immersive Storytelling Experience LUMINISCENCE Opens at St. Patrick's Cathedral, New York City
data.description: LUMINISCENCE, a project that began three years ago, now offers guests the opportunity to immerse themselves in the iconic landmark of St. Patrick's through a combination of light, music, and storytelling. data.title: New EEI Report Shows How Electric Companies Are Supporting Customers, Helping Families Manage Energy Costs
data.description: A recent report highlighting customer assistance programs and energy-saving initiatives was published by the Edison Electric Institute (EEI) in Washington on October 2, 2026. Titled "Powering Customer Savings: Helping Residential Customers Save on Energy Costs," the report focuses on demonstrating strategies for American residential customers to save on energy expenses. This comprehensive report provides valuable insights into various programs designed to assist consumers in managing their energy consumption effectively. Its findings shed light on successful initiatives that have enabled households to save a significant amount on energy expenses. The data and analysis put forth in the report quantify the positive impact of these strategies, emphasizing the potential for substantial savings for residential customers nationwide. The report underlines the importance of such initiatives in promoting energy efficiency and financial savings for consumers, indicating a growing trend towards more sustainable and cost-effective energy consumption practices.

data.title: APFC Holds Annual Meeting of the Board of Trustees in Nome
data.description: In Nome, Alaska, the Alaska Permanent Fund Corporation's Board of Trustees recently held their Annual Meeting on September 30 and October 1, 2026, both in-person and online. During the meeting, the trustees assessed the performance of the Fund in Fiscal Year 2026, delved into a comprehensive analysis of the Real Estate portfolio, approved a revised Investment Policy Statement, and formed a Benchmark Review Committee. Additionally, as per their yearly governance duties, the Board selected corporate officers. Key numbers discussed at the meeting included the fund's financial performance in FY 2026 and the various portfolios under review.
